create_TactileDepth_vit: create a TactileDepth instance with depth_mode vit to load a TouchVIT model for tactile depth estimation
run_image2heightmap: run image2heightmap on a tactile sensor image to get a blended depth heightmap tensor
run_heightmap2mask: run heightmap2mask on a heightmap tensor to produce a binary contact mask from background template
run_blend_heightmaps: run blend_heightmaps to apply exponentially weighted temporal blending across a sliding window of heightmaps
review_TactileDepth_init: review the TactileDepth class init to understand depth_mode, real, and device configuration options
